name: Fictional customer - code review sample

sdlc.current: Change intent and test evidence are separated, causing review gaps.
sdlc.desired: Read the implementation and the real test results together and report important defects with evidence.

glossary.implementation: The local changes to review and their intent
glossary.review-report: A read-only report distinguishing requirements, defects, test evidence, and unverified items

pains.description: Review stays at surface checks and misses important behavior errors.
pains.impact: Fixes are delayed and re-review is needed.
pains.frequency: Fictional example; the real frequency is not verified.

success_criteria: Important findings include the file location, impact, and reproduction evidence.
Do not invent test results that were not provided.
constraints: This is fictional customer information; the real repository rules and branches are not verified.
The review is read-only and does not auto-fix, publish, approve, or merge.

facts.statement: The sample content is fictional material used to illustrate product behavior.
facts.evidence: Development fixture included in the repository

assumptions: At run time the implementation and test-results are provided together.
unknowns: The real severity criteria and required regression tests are not verified.
